why_clusterer_split: merge_key requires EXACT equality after case/punctuation normalisation. Singular vs plural, and an inserted word ('Holding'), are different token sequences, so they never entered the same cluster. That strictness is deliberate - it is what keeps 'Patent A' out of 'Patent' - so these pairs need a ruling, not a looser clusterer.
